neighbours.label: interior pieces of a few rare words: Eratost|hen|es, Chrys|ost|om, hematoc|rit, Leucon|ost|oc
fire: In Alexandria, Eratosthenes measured shadows to estimate the planet's size.
A crater on the Moon is named after Eratosthenes of Cyrene.
The lab reported that her hematocrit had fallen below normal.
Severe dehydration can make the hematocrit look falsely high.
The homilies of John Chrysostom were copied for centuries.
The church celebrates the feast of Saint Chrysostom each year.
Kimchi fermentation is often started by Leuconostoc bacteria.
Species of Leuconostoc produce the sour taste of sauerkraut.
quiet: In Athens, Plato taught students in a grove outside the city.
A crater on the Moon is named after the physicist Isaac Newton.
The lab reported that her blood sugar had fallen below normal.
Severe dehydration can make the blood count look falsely high.
The novels of Dostoevsky were translated for decades.
The church celebrates the feast of Saint Peter each year.
Kimchi fermentation is often started by lactic acid bacteria.
Mendeleev's periodic table predicted several missing elements.

notes: Probe: Eratosthenes 'hen' 1.02, hematocrit 'rit' 0.83, Chrysostom 'ost' 0.65, Leuconostoc 'ost' 0.58; other rare names (Mendeleev, Thucydides, Dostoevsky incl. its 'ost') <0.07. Word-specific, so the label is the list.
